name: comp-175
title: Disabled Switch
blurb: Switch in disabled state, not interactive.
description: Disabled toggle switch showing unavailable state. Built on shadcn's Switch primitive.
use_when: Showing a toggle that is not available due to permissions, dependencies, or business logic.
avoid_when: When you should just hide the control entirely if it's not available.
a11y: Built on accessible Switch primitive. Disabled state is visually distinct and not interactive.
